The data of the production of cars of five companies from the year 1989 to 1994

**Calculation:**

According to the table,

For car P → 8 16 > 17 6 (no continuous increase)

For car Q → 16 > 10 12 = 12 17 > 16 > 15 > 13 > 8 (no continuous increase)

For car S →** 4 18 14 From the table, we can clearly see that only for the car type ' S ' there is a continuous increase in production in each year from 1989 to 1994
